name: Are there specific brands of garbage disposals that CG Plumbing Solutions recommends?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific brands of garbage disposals that CG Plumbing Solutions recommends?

acceptedAnswer.text: While we install and service all major brands of garbage disposals, some brands are known for their durability and performance, such as InSinkErator and Waste King. Our technicians can provide recommendations based on your specific needs, budget, and desired features (like quiet operation or grinding power) during an on-site visit. Our first-party insight is that choosing a reputable brand often results in fewer service calls over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: We install all major brands, but often recommend InSinkErator and Waste King for durability. Our technicians can advise on the best option for your needs and budget.
